<span role="heading" class="bdt-ep-title-text bdt-flex-inline bdt-flex-middle" >Are prices net, and which currency do you charge in?							</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-content bdt-accordion-content"><p>All prices are Net including service and taxes.</p><p>We charge in Rupiah (IDR) &#8211; Estimations displayed in USD are for information only.</p><p>For big groups or long stay, contact us directly to discuss commercial conditions.</p></div></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-item"><div							class="bdt-ep-accordion-title bdt-accordion-title bdt-flex bdt-flex-middle bdt-flex-between" id="bdt-ep-accordion-how-can-i-pay-for-my-stay"

<span role="heading" class="bdt-ep-title-text bdt-flex-inline bdt-flex-middle" >How can I pay for my stay?							</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-content bdt-accordion-content"><p>DEPOSIT can be done through Wise or classic bank transfer.<br />CHECK-OUT bill can be settled by either cash, debit or credit card.</p><p>We do not accept foreign currencies.</p></div></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-item"><div							class="bdt-ep-accordion-title bdt-accordion-title bdt-flex bdt-flex-middle bdt-flex-between" id="bdt-ep-accordion-what-is-your-deposit-and-cancellation-policy"

<span role="heading" class="bdt-ep-title-text bdt-flex-inline bdt-flex-middle" >What is your deposit and cancellation policy?							</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-content bdt-accordion-content"><p>A 50% deposit of the accommodation amount booked is required to confirm your booking.</p><p>Cancellation fees apply on the deposit:<br />≥ 30 days = fully reimbursed<br />15 &#8211; 30 days = 50% reimbursed<br />&lt; 15 days = no reimbursement</p></div></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-item"><div							class="bdt-ep-accordion-title bdt-accordion-title bdt-flex bdt-flex-middle bdt-flex-between" id="bdt-ep-accordion-do-i-need-a-visa-to-visit-indonesia"

<i aria-hidden="true" class="fa-fw ti ti-plus"></i>										</span>
<span class="bdt-ep-accordion-icon-opened">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="fa-fw ti ti-minus"></i>										</span>

<span role="heading" class="bdt-ep-title-text bdt-flex-inline bdt-flex-middle" >Do I need a visa to visit Indonesia?							</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-content bdt-accordion-content"><p>Tourist Visa (C1 &#8211; 60 days)</p><ul><li>Price $50 (1M IDR)</li><li>Online &#8211; processed in 5 days</li><li>Extension twice of 60 days</li></ul><p>Visa On Arrival (VOA &#8211; 30 days)</p><ul><li>Price $25 (500K IDR)</li><li>Extension once 30 days</li></ul><p>The penalties for overstaying your visa will cost you $70 by day.</p><p>Official immigration website to apply: <a href="https://evisa.imigrasi.go.id/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">evisa.imigrasi.go.id</a></p></div></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-item"><div							class="bdt-ep-accordion-title bdt-accordion-title bdt-flex bdt-flex-middle bdt-flex-between" id="bdt-ep-accordion-how-do-i-get-from-makassar-airport-to-jeneponto"
data-accordion-index="4" data-title="how-do-i-get-from-makassar-airport-to-jeneponto"><span class="bdt-ep-accordion-icon bdt-flex-align-right"
aria-hidden="true"><span class="bdt-ep-accordion-icon-closed">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="fa-fw ti ti-plus"></i>										</span>
<span class="bdt-ep-accordion-icon-opened">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="fa-fw ti ti-minus"></i>										</span>
</span>
<span role="heading" class="bdt-ep-title-text bdt-flex-inline bdt-flex-middle" >How do I get from Makassar airport to Jeneponto?							</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-content bdt-accordion-content"><p>We are in Mallasoro village, 80 km from Makassar airport (UPG). We organise private car transfers both ways.</p><p>Duration: about 3 hours<br>Price (one way): IDR 1,000,000 (about $60)</p></div></div><div class="bdt-ep-accordion-item"><div							class="bdt-ep-accordion-title bdt-accordion-title bdt-flex bdt-flex-middle bdt-flex-between" id="bdt-ep-accordion-how-do-i-fly-to-makassar-from-abroad"
